bio.text: Dina Titus represents Nevada's 1st Congressional District and serves on the House Foreign Affairs and Transportation and Infrastructure committees.
Before Congress she was Nevada State Senate Minority Leader from 1993 to 2009, and she taught political science at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, from 1979 until 2011.
She grew up in Tifton, Georgia, and graduated from the College of William and Mary, with a master's degree from the University of Georgia and a doctorate from Florida State University.
